subject: Reminder: cleanup notes
text: Just a reminder to send the notes from the neighborhood cleanup before Friday. The turnout was unexpectedly good, and several people asked when the next one happens. Please include any photos or vendor contacts you took while there. If possible, add a few lines about what worked well, since that will help the next planning group. I will compile everything for the community bulletin so we can thank participants promptly. Let me know if you need the sign-in sheet. The updated flyer will list volunteers by evening. I appreciate it. Thanks.
